items.title: 68113_Barney Bigard oral history interview
items.q: The interviewee (Barney Bigard) narrates stories about Sidney Bechet working with Duke Ellington and opening a speakeasy with Lorenzo Tio, but does not describe a direct personal or professional relationship between himself and Sidney.

ctx.x: I had another -- Sidney, yes. Well, he was killed. He was shot. He and some other guy were fighting over his wife. That's a long time ago.
